look.summary_zh: 冷色 · 提亮中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 151.0/255（变化 +23.5 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.043。中灰红减蓝 -23.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F5DFE5、#DEB29E、#995C49；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #D5062E、#45C944、#404DE8。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 151.0/255 (+23.5 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.043; mid-gray red minus blue -23.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F5DFE5, #DEB29E, #995C49. Red/green/blue swatches: #D5062E, #45C944, #404DE8.
look.suggested_use_zh: 冷色城市、夜景与科技试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
